description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Present a question to the Clerk. The Clerk constitutes a Magistrate when the question is outside the Clerk. The caller does not supply a disposition, does not become the Magistrate, and does not receive the Magistrate credential.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of the matter you are admitted to (returned by atlas.bind_actor). Optional when you are bound to exactly one matter.

question.description: What you want to find or ask, in plain words.

related_matter_id.description: Optional id of another matter your question relates to.

name: atlas.magistrate_referral
title: Magistrate referral
